universal_lens: The NFL betting market is modeled as a non-equilibrium thermodynamic system where the closing spread represents a metastable state. Oddsmaker shading introduces an external potential field driven by retail cognitive biases, while line drift acts as a temporal diffusion process. True predictive expectation requires isolating the pure probability gradient from these liquidity-induced distortions.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal inference to construct dynamic prediction intervals around true win probabilities. By treating oddsmaker shading as a known bias vector, we apply Bayesian shrinkage to historical priors. This corrects the empirical distribution of point differentials, ensuring our probabilistic forecasts maintain strict calibration against the distorted closing line baseline.
gse_mapping: GSE translates these statistical edges into discrete state transitions within `devig.ts`. The engine monitors real-time liquidity flows to detect mid-week steam moves and key number hesitations (3, 7, 10). It executes selective pass discipline, mapping continuous probability gradients to binary trade actions only when the expected value strictly exceeds the bookmaker's vigorish barrier.
